entries.name: InfoList
entries.purpose: Domain-neutral list of leading media/title/sub/trailing badge-action-value rows.
strain_notes: Before creating domain-specific list rows, check whether trailing semantics can be represented here.

entries.name: SelectableList
entries.purpose: Option/filter/method selection list with WDS RadioGroup semantics.
strain_notes: If selection mode or nested detail grows, prefer adding semantic axes over new one-off selectors.

entries.name: ConsentList
entries.purpose: Required/optional consent list with all-agree state and local completion state.
strain_notes: Good candidate to align with x_interactions: interactive + sync + enabled.

entries.name: NoticeBlock
entries.purpose: Policy, warning, critical, or informational notice block.
strain_notes: Do not use PromoBlock for policy/legal notices.

entries.name: PromoBlock
entries.purpose: Promotion/coupon/offer block with optional action and media label.
strain_notes: Not for legal notice or policy guidance.

entries.name: SectionCard
strain_notes: Avoid over-cardifying simple flow screens; check x_interfacePlan.genre before use.

entries.name: SummaryCard
entries.purpose: Top media + label/title + meta body summary structure.
strain_notes: For complete-stage screens, prefer single result summary over step-by-step completion lists.

entries.name: MediaBlock
entries.purpose: Media slot for image, placeholder, skeleton-like or badge-bearing visual blocks.
strain_notes: Media-heavy pages should still preserve ContentOutlet/ContentSection ownership.

entries.name: PrimaryCTABar
entries.purpose: Docked primary CTA surface for single primary action with optional secondary and helper.
strain_notes: CTA enabled/disabled should be represented in x_stateMatrix and x_interactions.

entries.name: StickyActionBar
entries.purpose: Purchase/action bar with optional AI/price/title copy and secondary actions.
strain_notes: Use PrimaryCTABar for flow-style next/submit screens; use StickyActionBar for product/action commerce bars.

entries.name: FormField
entries.purpose: Label + control + message wrapper for form controls.
strain_notes: Validation states should be in x_stateMatrix instead of being implicit in copy.

entries.name: QueryBar
strain_notes: Search screens should classify x_uxStage.primary as search unless another task dominates.

entries.name: FilterTabs
strain_notes: Tabs in top chrome should be composed through global chrome organisms, not page-local fixed elements.

entries.name: ChipGroup
strain_notes: If chips become selectable state, record interaction tags or promote an axis.
